name: Dana Capek
source:
Despite her young appearance, she is a very sharp-tongued girl.
She has a strangely mature side to her.
The Piper's Clan announces the arrival of the great festival (Maag Mälar).
They bring the protagonist to the capital.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040202001505/http://www.cherrysoft.co.jp/cherrysoft/kyrie.htm]the official site[/url]]
